content.rendered:
Join us for a fun and informative Pre-K Open House! Our 2025-2026 program is open to all 4 and 5 year olds and includes full day and half day options!

When: January 15, 2025, Drop in anytime between 4:00 pm & 6:00 pm (Front entrance will open at 3:55)

Where: The Pre-K Classrooms at Hawks View Elementary and Middleton Elementary

Come meet our amazing teachers, explore our engaging learning spaces, and learn more about our exciting Pre-K program.

  • Discover our play-based curriculum designed to foster creativity, curiosity, and social-emotional growth.
  • Meet other families and connect with our supportive community.
  • Ask any questions you may have.

We can’t wait to welcome you and your child to our Pre-K family! For more information about our Pre-K program, visit our website or contact prek@sherwood.k12.or.us
